The '''Talcene Transit''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]] was located on the Talcene Transit. It connected the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] with the [[Kuthic Worlds/Legends|Kuthic Worlds]], allowing cargo ships to run supplies between the two. The [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]] dominated three [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] along the Talcene Transit. The Talcene Transit shared its name with [[Talcene]],<ref name="TEA" /> a planet<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> situated along the Perlemian Trade Route<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />
